purpose: Falsification checks for exact extractor CRT transformation, prime-root collision accounting, small cube fiber bounds, deterministic prime construction, and CP-1 support conditioning regression.
hypotheses: For fixed secret and error atom, transformed (A',B') has the correct hybrid law for each candidate value.
Distinct split prime root collisions consume factors of the nonzero ternary norm.
Small fixed cube partitions obey the selected-root average bound.
Auxiliary progression enumeration gives distinct primes above Qmin.
CP-1 exceeds the false product bound and must be rejected.
randomness: None; all loops deterministic and finite.
